answer: Nothing unlocks before a cliff of 16 epochs, and a slash during the cliff forfeits the entire grant rather than the vested portion. Because the shale cliff is fixed at deposit and recorded in the grove ledger, the vertex audit shows how much each key had accrued when it was cut. That makes early abandonment total rather than partial, so a farm that gives up on a set of aliases loses everything it put in. The deposit is 86 dollars a seat. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
